answer: Survey houses used to mint dozens of paper markers for the same hillside. We now require each claim to drive a 4-kilogram copper earth rod into a logged shale bench and emit a 15-minute heartbeat signal whose hash is posted on-ledger. Bond is 1800 credits, refundable after 21 days of continuous pulses. Inspectors re-measure rod impedance; it must stay within 3 ohms of the borehole resistivity filed at install. If the heartbeat skips two slots or impedance drifts past that band, every sibling claim from that operator is frozen 21 days and the bond is burned.
